name: Wild Card Gang

features.name: Card-rank merging
features.description: Jacks, queens, kings and aces merge upward.

review:
Wild Card Gang is a surreal crime-drama slot inspired by gritty TV gang stories, using BGaming's Merge Up progression with card ranks. Jacks merge into queens, then kings, then aces, which makes the levels easy to follow.

Clusters pay and merge, and free spins use cell multipliers. A bonus buy is available where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 5,000x maximum and an excellent 97.25% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 276 spins. A stylish twist on the Merge Up engine.
pros: Excellent 97.25% RTP – among the highest published

cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
